title: Appointed as Assistant
original: It's time for my shift. If I'm interrupting your work, I can wait outside.

title: Talk 1
original: Have you gone through every new operator's personnel files and info?

title: Talk 2
original: Nowhere in the world is completely safe with a war going on. Not even Rhodes Island. Please remember that.

title: Talk 3
original: To be frank, you're surrounded by people from all walks of life. That can be quite dangerous, don't you think?

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: I'm surprised that so many other Sarkaz have come to Rhodes Island. What's more surprising is that they actually get along…

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: My bowgun may not be easy to operate, but it's just as powerful as the Laterano guns. I use it to defend the glory of my people.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: I see Firewatch is here. I can't believe she's using the name of our old guerrilla group as her codename. It's like time stopped for her the day her home was destroyed...

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: As for what happened between Firewatch and I... she'll tell you when she's ready. All I can say is that I was not the one who led the rebels to her village... but no one would believe the words of a Sarkaz, right?

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: She wants her revenge, and I have my duty. Even though we've met again at Rhodes Island, it probably won't affect anything. Our paths aren't likely to cross.

title: Idle
original: What's that sound? Is someone monitoring this room? Or am I just… imagining things?

title: Onboard
original: Codename Meteorite, a freelance mercenary. I'm Sarkaz, as you can see. Do you still want to hire me?

title: Watching Battle Record
original: My aim with my bowgun has improved.

title: Promotion 1
original: You want to promote me? I see that I made the right choice to work here.

title: Promotion 2
original: Thank you so much for this, really. I can't believe someone like me could work a stable job here at Rhodes Island. I'll do everything I can to repay your trust in me.

title: Added to Squad
original: Reporting for duty.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Me, a leader? To be honest, I'm not that good at giving orders.

title: Depart
original: I'll do my best to take care of everyone.

title: Begin Operation
original: Enemy status confirmed. All units, prepare to engage.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: All right.

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: No problem.

title: Deployment 1
original: I've got a clear shot.

title: Deployment 2
original: Let's take them all out.

title: In Battle 1
original: Fire!

title: In Battle 2
original: Open fire!

title: In Battle 3
original: Focus fire!

title: In Battle 4
original: Get back!

title: 4-star Result
original: I don't want to see anything laid to waste in the fires of war ever again. Let us put an end to this, once and for all.

title: 3-star Result
original: Trying to escape after I laid you to siege? Don't be silly.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: Someone's escaped. Not the time to let our guard down.

title: Operation Failure
original: Retreat! Back to the stronghold and regroup.

title: Assigned to Facility
original: What's this place?

title: Tap
original: Huh? Huh? What?

title: Trust Tap
original: Is this for me? Thanks.

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: That's another year, come and gone. Getting to live one more year is certainly worth celebrating as a merc, but more than that, I don't want anyone else living with this kind of uncertainty... Doctor, I got some presents for the kids of Rhodes Island. Could you hand them out for me?

title: Greeting
original: How's it going, Doctor?

title: Birthday
original: Happy birthday, Doctor. I want to take this chance to express my gratitude, for you are always looking out for me. I wasn't sure what would be a suitable gift... but I will give you an oath, I'll give it all I've got to protect you. Um… is that okay?

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: Before this, I'd never stayed with an organization for such a long time, and I haven't figured out my plans for the future, but I really wavered when I heard Amiya say, 'I want to help the Sarkaz.' Maybe there are still lots of people out there, with hope for the future in their hearts.
